home.toolsTitle: Choose what you want to do
home.toolsSubtitle: Click a card to open the tool and start right away.
home.faq1A: Yes. The goal is to offer simple, free tools for everyday use, with no hidden costs.
home.faq2Q: Do I need to create an account?
home.faq2A: No. You use FileFlip directly in your browser, with no sign-up.
home.faq3Q: Are the tools ready to use?

meta.defaultTitle: FileFlip — Free tools to convert and compress files
meta.defaultDescription: Convert and compress files online for free: images, PDFs, ZIPs. No account, everything in the browser. Compress images, merge PDFs, convert formats.

compressImage.label: Compress image
compressImage.short: Reduce the size of your photos.
compressImage.metaDescription: Compress JPG, PNG and WebP photos online for free. Reduce image size while keeping quality. No account, everything in the browser.

mergePdf.label: Merge PDF
mergePdf.short: Combine multiple PDFs into one file.
mergePdf.metaDescription: Combine multiple PDF files into one online. Drag and drop to reorder. No account, works in the browser.

compressPdf.label: Compress PDF
compressPdf.short: Reduce the size of PDF documents.
compressPdf.metaDescription: Reduce PDF file size online. Choose compression level. No account, in the browser.

jpgToPng.label: JPG → PNG
jpgToPng.metaDescription: Convert JPG to PNG online for free. No account, in the browser.

pngToJpg.label: PNG → JPG
pngToJpg.metaDescription: Convert PNG to JPG online for free. No account, in the browser.

imageToWebp.label: Image → WebP
imageToWebp.short: Convert to WebP for smaller files.
imageToWebp.metaDescription: Convert images to WebP online. No account, in the browser.

resizeImage.label: Resize images
resizeImage.short: Fit photos to websites, CVs and forms.
resizeImage.metaDescription: Resize images by width and height. No account, in the browser.

pdfToImages.label: PDF → Images
pdfToImages.metaDescription: Convert PDF pages to PNG images. Download single or ZIP. No account, in the browser.

createZip.label: Create ZIP archive
createZip.short: Bundle multiple files into one ZIP.
createZip.metaDescription: Create ZIP archives online. No account, in the browser.

extractZip.label: Extract ZIP
extractZip.short: Open and download files from an archive.
extractZip.metaDescription: Extract and download files from ZIP. No account, in the browser.

svgToPng.label: SVG to PNG
svgToPng.short: Convert SVG to PNG at any size.
svgToPng.metaDescription: Convert SVG to PNG online. Choose output width, preview and download. No account, in the browser.

removeBackground.label: Remove background
removeBackground.metaDescription: Remove background from images online. Get PNG with transparency. Works in the browser with no upload.

mergeImages.label: Merge images
mergeImages.short: Combine two images side by side.
mergeImages.metaDescription: Merge two images horizontally or vertically. Preview and download. No account, in the browser.

pdfToText.label: PDF to text
pdfToText.metaDescription: Extract text from PDF online. Copy or download as TXT. No account, in the browser.

addWatermark.label: Add watermark
addWatermark.metaTitle: Add Watermark to Image Online Free
addWatermark.metaDescription: Add text watermark to images. Choose position, opacity and size. Preview and download. In the browser.

colorConverter.label: Color converter
colorConverter.metaTitle: Color Converter HEX RGB HSL Free
colorConverter.metaDescription: Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL. Live preview. No account, in the browser.

faviconGenerator.label: Favicon generator
faviconGenerator.metaDescription: Generate favicons (16x16, 32x32, 48x48, 180x180) from an image. Download single or ZIP. In the browser.

compressVideo.label: Compress video
compressVideo.metaDescription: Compress MP4 video online. Choose quality, see progress, download. Works in the browser with WebAssembly.

extractAudio.label: Extract audio
extractAudio.metaTitle: Extract Audio from Video Online Free
extractAudio.metaDescription: Extract audio from MP4 video as MP3. Progress bar, download. Works in the browser.

wordCounter.label: Word counter
wordCounter.metaTitle: Word Counter and Text Stats Free
wordCounter.metaDescription: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs. Reading time and top words. No account, in the browser.

heicToJpg.label: HEIC to JPG
heicToJpg.short: Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG.
heicToJpg.metaDescription: Convert HEIC (iPhone) photos to JPG online. One or multiple files, preview, download single or ZIP. In the browser.
heicToJpg.faq1A: HEIC is the default photo format on iPhones. Converting to JPG makes photos easier to share. Conversion runs in your browser; files never leave your device.
heicToJpg.faq2A: Yes. Select multiple HEIC files. The tool shows progress and lets you download each JPG or all in a ZIP.
heicToJpg.faq3A: JPG is lossy; there can be a small quality reduction. For typical use the result is usually very good.
heicToJpg.faq4Q: Are my photos sent to a server?
heicToJpg.faq4A: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser. Your files never leave your device.
heicToJpg.faq5A: When you convert many files, one ZIP is faster than saving each JPG individually.
heicToJpg.errorConversionFailed: Conversion failed. Try other HEIC files.

removeMetadata.label: Remove metadata
removeMetadata.short: Strip EXIF from JPG and PNG.
removeMetadata.metaTitle: Remove Image Metadata EXIF Online Free
removeMetadata.metaDescription: Remove all EXIF metadata from JPG and PNG images. See metadata before removal, download clean image. In the browser.
removeMetadata.faq1A: EXIF stores camera, date, GPS, etc. inside images. This tool removes all such data by redrawing the image on a clean canvas.
removeMetadata.faq2Q: Can I see metadata before removing?
removeMetadata.faq2A: Yes. The tool displays the metadata found (using exifr) so you know what will be removed. You then download the cleaned image.
removeMetadata.faq3A: No. Everything runs in your browser. Your file never leaves your device.
removeMetadata.faq4A: JPG and PNG. The image is re-encoded without EXIF; appearance is unchanged.
removeMetadata.faq5A: No. Only embedded metadata is removed. Dimensions and pixels stay the same.

pdfToPptx.label: PDF to PowerPoint
pdfToPptx.metaTitle: PDF to PowerPoint PPTX Online Free
pdfToPptx.metaDescription: Convert PDF to PowerPoint. Each page becomes a slide. Progress bar, download PPTX. In the browser.
pdfToPptx.faq1Q: How does PDF to PowerPoint work?
pdfToPptx.faq1A: Each PDF page is rendered as an image and placed on a slide. One slide per page. The tool uses pdfjs-dist and pptxgenjs in your browser.
pdfToPptx.faq2Q: Is the text editable in the PPTX?
pdfToPptx.faq2A: No. Content is embedded as images. For editable text you would need OCR or another method.
pdfToPptx.faq3Q: Are my PDFs sent to a server?
pdfToPptx.faq3A: No. The PDF is processed entirely in your browser.
pdfToPptx.faq4Q: What if my PDF has many pages?
pdfToPptx.faq4A: Very long PDFs take longer. The progress bar shows how many pages have been processed.
pdfToPptx.faq5Q: Can I edit the slides after?
pdfToPptx.faq5A: Yes. You get a standard PPTX. Open in PowerPoint and add text, resize, or reorder.

colorPalette.label: Color palette
colorPalette.metaTitle: Extract Color Palette from Image Free
colorPalette.metaDescription: Extract 6 dominant colors from an image. HEX, RGB, HSL. Click to copy. Preview strips. In the browser.
colorPalette.faq1A: The tool reads pixel data from a canvas and uses color quantization (JavaScript) to find the 6 dominant colors. It shows HEX, RGB and HSL.
colorPalette.faq2Q: Can I copy a color code?
colorPalette.faq2A: Yes. Click a color swatch to copy its HEX code to the clipboard.
colorPalette.faq3A: No. The image is processed entirely in your browser.
colorPalette.faq4A: Any format the browser can draw (JPG, PNG, WebP, etc.).
colorPalette.faq5A: Six gives a clear, usable palette. You can use them as a starting point for design.

textDiff.label: Text diff
textDiff.metaTitle: Text Diff Compare Two Texts Free
textDiff.metaDescription: Compare two texts. Green for additions, red for removals. Word-by-word. Stats: added, removed, unchanged. In the browser.
textDiff.faq1A: Paste original and modified text. The tool uses the diff library for word-by-word changes. Additions in green, removals in red. Stats: added, removed, unchanged.
textDiff.faq2A: No. Everything runs in your browser. Your text is never sent to any server.
textDiff.faq3A: There is no fixed limit. Very long texts may take a moment to process.
textDiff.faq4A: Word-level diff shows exactly which words were added or removed within a line.
textDiff.faq5A: Added: words in modified but not original. Removed: words in original but not modified. Unchanged: in both.

encryptText.label: Encrypt text
encryptText.metaTitle: Encrypt Decrypt Text with Password Free
encryptText.metaDescription: Encrypt and decrypt text with AES-256 and a password. Password never sent to server. In the browser.
encryptText.faq1A: The tool uses crypto-js with AES-256. You enter a password; encryption runs in your browser. The password is never sent to any server.
encryptText.faq2A: No. The password is only used locally to encrypt or decrypt. You must remember it to decrypt later.
encryptText.faq3A: Yes. Copy the encrypted string and share it. The recipient needs the same password to decrypt (e.g. with this tool).
encryptText.faq4Q: What if I lose the password?
encryptText.faq4A: There is no way to recover the text without the password. Keep it in a safe place.
encryptText.faq5A: AES-256 is a strong standard. Security also depends on a strong password and not sharing it.

markdownToHtml.label: Markdown to HTML
markdownToHtml.short: Convert Markdown to HTML with preview.
markdownToHtml.metaDescription: Convert Markdown to HTML. Live preview, code highlighting. Download full page or copy content HTML. In the browser.
markdownToHtml.faq1A: Markdown is a simple syntax for formatting text. This tool converts it to HTML with live preview and code highlighting (highlight.js).
markdownToHtml.faq2A: No. Conversion runs in your browser. Your text is never sent to any server.
markdownToHtml.faq3A: Full HTML page or just the content HTML to paste into an existing page or CMS.
markdownToHtml.faq4A: Yes. highlight.js is used for syntax highlighting in code blocks in the preview.
markdownToHtml.faq5A: The marked library supports headings, bold, italic, lists, links, images, code blocks, blockquotes, tables, etc.

qrGenerator.label: QR code generator
qrGenerator.metaDescription: Generate QR codes. URL, email, phone, WiFi. Custom size, colors, logo. Download PNG or SVG. In the browser.
qrGenerator.faq1Q: What can I put in a QR code?
qrGenerator.faq1A: URL, text, email, phone, or WiFi. The tool has presets for URL, email, phone and WiFi.
qrGenerator.faq2A: Yes. Size, QR color, background color, and optional logo in the center. Download as PNG or SVG.
qrGenerator.faq3A: A small center logo usually still allows scanning. Very large logos can reduce reliability.
qrGenerator.faq4A: No. The QR is generated in your browser. Your content is never sent to any server.
qrGenerator.faq5A: PNG is raster; SVG is vector and scales without quality loss.

extractFrames.label: Extract video frames
extractFrames.metaDescription: Extract frames from video as JPG. Choose count or interval. Grid preview, download single or ZIP. In the browser.
extractFrames.faq1A: The tool uses the HTML5 video element and canvas. It seeks to chosen times, draws each frame to canvas, and exports as JPG. No server or FFmpeg.
extractFrames.faq2A: Any format your browser can play (typically MP4). The video is read locally.
extractFrames.faq3Q: Can I choose how many frames?
extractFrames.faq3A: Yes. Set the number of frames (evenly spaced) or the interval in seconds.
extractFrames.faq4A: No. Processing is entirely in your browser.
extractFrames.faq5A: When you extract many frames, a ZIP is more convenient than saving each image one by one.

csvTools.label: CSV tools
csvTools.metaTitle: CSV Merge and Split Tools Free
csvTools.metaDescription: Merge multiple CSVs or split one by row count. Preview, download. Handles headers. In the browser.
csvTools.faq1Q: What can the CSV tool do?
csvTools.faq1A: Merge: combine two or more CSVs into one (with optional duplicate header handling). Split: divide one CSV by row count and download parts as ZIP.
csvTools.faq2A: You can keep the first file's header and skip duplicate headers from other files. Preview before downloading.
csvTools.faq3A: PapaParse is used to read and write CSV. It handles quoted fields and different line endings.
csvTools.faq4A: No. All processing runs in your browser. Your CSVs never leave your device.
csvTools.faq5Q: Can I split by custom row count?
csvTools.faq5A: Yes. In the split tab you choose how many rows per file. The tool chunks the CSV and offers them in a ZIP.
csvTools.mergeDesc: Upload 2 or more CSV files. Headers from the first file are used; duplicate headers in other files are skipped.
csvTools.splitDesc: Upload one CSV. It will be split into parts (each with this many rows).
